payload.abstract: Released by the Information Technologies Institute (CERTH-ITI) and powered by MAMEM HORIZON 2020, the MSSVEP database contains EEG recordings of 11 subjects under the stimulation of flickering lights, used to study the steady state visually evoked potentials. The data is divided into three sets in which the experimental procedures and capturing devices differ.
